description: Write preformatted TSV records in encounter order, appending one LF after every record.

interface.semantic_input: Ordered UTF-8 TSV record text with delimiters already present, without embedded CR, LF or NUL, and a destination pathname.
interface.semantic_output: A file containing the caller-formatted records with LF terminators and no added header.

implementation_form: existing C++ line writer with a TSV sink registration
resources: Uses a temporary destination and writes each record separately. General resource and pathname bounds remain unmeasured.

preconditions.detail: The caller supplies already-delimited UTF-8 records without embedded CR, LF or NUL and a destination with a writable parent.

postconditions.detail: Preserved the exact supplied record bytes with an LF after each record. A zero-record input produced zero bytes, and an empty record produced one LF.

refinements.detail: Leading, trailing and adjacent tabs remained unchanged. The raw writer also preserved embedded line breaks and NUL in separate byte probes outside the qualified textual domain.

effects.detail: Successful writes replaced the destination. Directory and missing-parent failures were detected. Under the tested process size limit, the call preserved a regular destination's previous bytes or left an absent destination absent.

invariants.detail: The direct writer retained order, duplicate records, punctuation and UTF-8 bytes in the frozen cases.

mathematical_properties.detail: Every successful direct fixture matched the sum of record sizes plus one LF per record.

formal_predicates.detail: The detached scope describes the intended input. No general proof of write success, rollback, durability or TSV validity was attempted.

state_protocol.detail: The call opens a local QSaveFile, writes the record bytes and terminators, then commits synchronously.

ownership.detail: The record vector and destination pathname are borrowed during the call.

upstream_usage.detail: The historical TSV registration reuses the byte-preserving x09 line sink with the distinct TSV output port.

specification_question.detail: Do upstream report operations already supply tab delimiters and one record per string? This sink writes the supplied bytes and adds record terminators.
